plugins.name: the-engine
plugins.description: The Assistant by Horizon Found. Two ways in. Bring it photos you've already finished and it makes your posts: a reel cut to the beat, a carousel, stories, and captions in your voice. Or plug in a memory card, say backup now, and walk away: it backs the card up, checks every photo, sorts and names your shoots, and leaves you a report. Never posts anything itself.
